title: Minimizing capture time with many small traps in heterogeneous media
summary: We study the problem of optimally placing a large number of small absorbing traps to minimize the mean first-passage time (MFPT) of particles diffusing in a heterogeneous medium with space-dependent diffusivity $D(x)$ and prescribed initial particle distribution $ω(x)$. In two and three dimensions we identify two distinct regimes, depending on how strongly the trap ensemble depletes the particles.
